rationale: The fixed comparison confirms a real original-scenario regression: V17 has 139/160 useful answers against V77 122/160. Historical percentages also mixed corpora and budgets; both facts must be reported.

No frozen revision qualifies for rollout. V17 has 56 accepted answer errors and weak recent coverage. V31 improves worst-block coverage but gains only five useful answers overall against V77, loses original-block coverage, and has 13 accepted answer errors. This falls below the declared eight-answer threshold for a large port and provides no consistent block advantage.

V77 entirely loses the same four source families in both runs: legacy alternatives, legacy personal report, nested report, and assistant speculation. The frozen report-audit and retrieval-unit changes address the observed retention boundaries while preserving existing source/language checks. This is a prospective hypothesis, not a measured recovery.

V77 publishes three selected-source-name errors and eight open-question qualification omissions. The exact-name guard deterministically addresses the former publication boundary; the shared retrieval-unit instruction targets the latter extraction/selection boundary and remains model-dependent.

All revisions share six ordinary Markdown classification failures. The isolated category-heading fix and projection migration address this independently demonstrated defect; it receives no managed-answer score credit.
evaluation: Run this one frozen integration on all 22 existing cases twice, with the exact same 352 coordinates, roles, output ceilings, source-first obligations, grader contract, and fixed 80% per-block/run target. Preserve 90% as a separate historical target. No selective rerun or further live tuning follows.
disposition: Selection authorizes the final bounded evaluation. It does not declare a reliability pass or approve general rollout. Finish the engineering work in PR #70 with actual results and remaining limits.
budget: Conservatively six of the ten allowed iterations: two previously charged, three comparison arms, and this single integration.
